limits.MMIO: unmapped; unintended peripheral access stops the experiment
limits.ring: synthetic frame bytes and read/producer indices at observed stock ring addresses
limits.dispatch_link: host reproduces caller accepted-flag branch between actual parser and actual dispatcher
limits.read_backing: core cases: synthetic byte value (address + offset) & 255; separate NOR roundtrip uses its byte array
limits.write_backing: core cases: RMW call capture only; separate NOR roundtrip mutates only its synthetic byte array
limits.request_buffer_tail: 160-byte observed gap initialized to 0x5a; not an allocation-size claim
limits.malformed_cases: function-level observations, not a physical exploitability assessment

static_usb_descriptors.interpretation: CDC ACM communication interface plus CDC data interface

synthetic_nor_roundtrip.request_write_layout: CPS 0.56 fixed inner length 12, 128-byte padded data, 144-byte body

synthetic_record.name: MODEL77
synthetic_record.derived_frequency_note: Applies 0x080059EC directly to raw values; loader field/band validation and reverse are not applied.

synthetic_nor_roundtrip.limitations: Synthetic byte-array persistence only; no physical NOR, power-loss durability, USB enumeration, RF or device programming.

synthetic_count_data_mismatch.synthetic_stale_buffer_explanation: 4 supplied data bytes + 2 copied checksum bytes + 10 initialized 0x5a bytes; RMW is a capture hook and no storage is changed
